relations.subject: Walther Wüst
relations.evidence: He studied Indology and other subjects... at the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München... He received his PhD at the age of 22 with a dissertation on the Rigveda

relations.subject: Walther Wüst
relations.evidence: Wüst became a private lecturer in Sanskrit by 1926 and later a professor.

relations.subject: Walther Wüst
relations.role: Professor of Aryan Culture and Linguistics and Dean of the Faculty of Philosophy
relations.evidence: In early 1935, Wüst became Professor of Aryan Culture and Linguistics and Dean of the Faculty of Philosophy at the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München

relations.subject: Walther Wüst
relations.evidence: served as Rector of the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München from 1941 to 1945.

relations.subject: Davud Monshizadeh
relations.evidence: Notable students of Wüst included Davud Monshizadeh

relations.subject: Karl Hoffmann
relations.evidence: he was also Doktorvater (Dissertation Chair) to the linguist Karl Hoffmann.

relations.subject: Walther Wüst
relations.evidence: In that same year, Wüst was also editing the scholarly journal, Wörter und Sachen (Words and Things) along with Heidelberg Academy of Sciences and Humanities member and fellow linguist, Hermann Güntert.
